I think the goal might be to move the blocks up to cover the "+" symbol. The "+" is at rows 31-33, and the blocks are 5 rows tall (rows 45-49). So if I move the blocks up, they would cover rows 31-35, which includes the "+" at rows 31-33.
Let me try pressing UP multiple times to move the blocks up to the "+" position. The blocks are at rows 45-49, and I want them at rows 31-35. That's a difference of 14 rows, which is about 2-3 UP actions (5 rows each).
Actually, wait. Looking at my earlier tests:
- From rows 45-49, pressing UP once moved the blocks to rows 40-44.
- Pressing UP 5 more times moved the blocks to rows 25-29.
So each UP action moves the blocks up by 5 rows. From rows 45-49, pressing UP once moves to rows 40-44, pressing UP again moves to rows 35-39, pressing UP again moves to rows 30-34, and pressing UP again moves to rows 25-29.
So to get the blocks to rows 31-35, I would need to press UP 3 times (from rows 45-49 to rows 30-34).
Let me try pressing UP 3 times.
